# Fixtures

`acme_retail/` is the sample bundle from [GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format) at commit `ad30107c31c06aec8a7d5636e0d1058118604e6f` (`bundles/acme_retail`, without `viz.html`), under the Apache License 2.0 in `LICENSE-open-knowledge-format.md`.

The unit tests do not read it: the test environment has no file system. Link it into `~/.claude/okf/` to try cc-okf by hand.
